item.title: Bureaucratic Delay no Ground for Condonation; Supreme Court dismisses SLP as time-barred for State being ‘utterly lethargic, tardy and indolent’
item.description: “Despite all the latitude that is shown to a “State”, we are of the clear opinion that 10 the cause sought to be shown here by the State of Odisha is not an explanation but a lame excuse. No case for exercise of discretion has been set up.” The post Bureaucratic Delay no Ground for Condonation; Supreme Court dismisses SLP as time-barred for State being ‘utterly lethargic, tardy and indolent’ appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Mere act of charging high interest doesn’t amount to abetment to commit suicide: Delhi High Court
item.description: Although much emphasis is laid on the calls received by the deceased on the day of his death and the petitioner has sought to argue that the manner of demanding repayment constitutes as harassment, in the opinion of this Court, even if the allegations are taken at the highest, such incessant pestering still falls short of instigation. The post Mere act of charging high interest doesn’t amount to abetment to commit suicide: Delhi High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Jharkhand High Court raises concern over rampant trafficking, seeks National SOP on Aadhaar disclosure for missing children
item.description: “What will happen in other cases where the parents of missing or trafficked children are themselves facing the rigors of trafficking of their own child and are not in a position to approach the Court.” The post Jharkhand High Court raises concern over rampant trafficking, seeks National SOP on Aadhaar disclosure for missing children appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Acquisition without Compensation is Unconstitutional: Bombay HC criticises State over Systemic Failure in Land Acquisition Proceedings
item.description: “A large number of cases disclosed unjustified delay of nearly three decades in completing land acquisition proceedings even after taking possession of the petitioners’ lands which resulted not only in grave prejudice to the landowners but also in substantial and avoidable financial burden on the public exchequer.” The post Acquisition without Compensation is Unconstitutional: Bombay HC criticises State over Systemic Failure in Land Acquisition Proceedings appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Inside Landmark UK Supreme Court Ruling: Artificial Neural Networks can qualify for Patent Protection
item.description: “It is sufficient to show that the subject matter of the claims has technical character and is not to a computer program “as such”. It follows that the UKIPO was wrong to decide, for the reason it did, that the application for a patent should be refused.” The post Inside Landmark UK Supreme Court Ruling: Artificial Neural Networks can qualify for Patent Protection appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Allahabad HC quashes criminal case against students for offering Namaz at restricted place
item.description: The Court remarked that the in India, citizens of every faith, belief of different caste, creed and religion are free to follow their faith and belief as per their own rituals. However, considering the mixed culture of the society, certain yardstick and the suggestions have to be followed by the citizens. The post Allahabad HC quashes criminal case against students for offering Namaz at restricted place appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Massive SCOTUS verdict on ‘Trump Tariffs’: IEEPA does not authorise US President to impose tariffs
item.description: After becoming US President for the 2nd time, President Donald Trump imposed tariffs by invoking his authority under International Emergency Economic Powers Act to deal with influx of illegal drugs from Canada, Mexico and large and persistent trade deficits. The post Massive SCOTUS verdict on ‘Trump Tariffs’: IEEPA does not authorise US President to impose tariffs appeared first on SCC Times.
